items.name: notchset-skill
items.title: Notchset agent skill
items.description: Teaches Claude Code and other agents to find, install and compose Notchset items with the library's design, motion and copy rules.

items.name: notchset-ai
items.title: Notchset AI rules
items.description: Rules and a routing table that tell Claude Code, Cursor and other agents how to use Notchset components in this project.

items.name: notchset-font-body
items.title: Notchset sans font (Inter)
items.description: Inter from Google Fonts as --font-inter.

items.name: notchset-font-sans
items.title: Notchset sans font (Geist)
items.description: Geist from Google Fonts as --font-sans.

items.name: notchset-font-mono
items.title: Notchset mono font (Geist Mono)
items.description: Geist Mono from Google Fonts as --font-mono.

items.name: base
items.title: Notchset base
items.description: A new project set up for Notchset: the theme and its fonts, the foundation every item needs, and the @notchset and @notchset-pro registries in components.json.

items.name: notchset-theme
items.title: Notchset theme
items.description: The shadcn tokens in light and dark, in the Cobalt, Amethyst and Graphite Signatures. Optional: the components follow any shadcn theme.

items.name: notchset-foundation
items.title: Notchset foundation
items.description: The roles every component is built from (surfaces, ink, signal, type, space, sizes, radii, motion), read from the shadcn tokens. Installed once, by any component.

items.name: account-card
items.title: Account card
items.description: One outside thing the workspace is tied to (an email account, a calendar, a card on file): its state beside the name, whose it is and how fresh, and its actions. Off, it says what connecting does and offers the ways to connect.

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account menu
items.description: The menu behind your avatar: your name, sign-in address and plan; your workspace with Switch; the theme; Settings, help and Sign out last. Switch slides your workspaces in place as its second mode; picking one switches. On a phone it is the one bottom sheet.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: What happened on a record, newest first by day: who did it, what and when, emails and notes with their words. Chips filter by kind and the rows glide; new events wait above as a pill instead of shoving what you read; Mark all read clears the unread marks; older entries wait behind one line.

items.name: agent-settings
items.title: Agent settings
items.description: An agent's model, permissions, tools, memory and spend on one calm page. A changed row wears a Signature dot until Publish; the dark save bar counts the changes. Try it opens a drawer that answers with the unsaved draft, so a flipped permission shows its gate. First run steps the same parts.

items.name: answer
items.title: Answer
items.description: The assistant's reply as one piece: what it read folds into one line ("Read 3 sources") like the thinking above it; each claim takes one numbered mark that opens its passage. Stop keeps what it wrote with Continue; a failed answer keeps its words with Retry. Built on Message and Sources.

items.name: api-key-list
items.title: API key list
items.description: The keys a workspace has made, each named for what uses it and shown by its last four, with its scope, when it was made and last used, and by whom. Revoke asks once, in red; a revoked key stays listed, quiet.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact workspace
items.description: The document beside a thread. While the assistant writes, each changed passage lands as its change hunk; Keep or Undo each in place as the header counts what is left. An undone one leaves a quiet line with Redo. Versions name who made them; none is lost. Select a passage to Ask about this; edit by hand for your own.

items.name: ask-chart
items.title: Ask chart
items.description: A question about your data becomes its query, shown in plain terms as it is written, so a wrong filter is caught first. Run, it folds to one line with its count. The bars draw a region at a time, then the answer, whose cite marks light their bars and a bar its sentence. No rows says so; a word it can't map is named.

items.name: attachment-list
items.title: Attachment list
items.description: A record's files, each saying where it really is: uploading with its share, stored with who added it, kept in this browser when nothing was uploaded, or not uploaded and why, still listed so it can be tried again. Drop files on it or choose them; storage and progress are the host's.

items.name: board-card
items.title: Board card
items.description: One card for a pipeline's deals and a board's tasks: a mark and whose it is, what it is worth, the title, and how long it has sat in its stage. Given a signal it reads as a deal: brand and amount, the deal, ONE signal as an icon and words, days and the owner's face. The stage's colour stays on the column's head.

items.name: board-extras
items.title: Board extras
items.description: Board's opt-in parts, installed only by a board that uses them. QuickAdd: New deal at a column's foot, the company picked as you type, with Undo. DealLook: a card's quick look, grown into a sheet beside the board. ScoutMove, ScoutQueue, ScoutActivity: Scout's suggested moves with their evidence.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: Records in columns by stage, or by owner in lanes every card flies to. A card lifts and tilts under the hand and springs into its open slot; the heads' counts and totals roll; the notice offers Undo (⌘Z). Won and Lost rise while one is held. New deal waits at a column's foot; a press opens the quick look.

items.name: bulk-bar
items.title: Bulk bar
items.description: Appears at the bottom of a list once rows are selected: how many, what applies to all of them, the destructive one last and red. Esc or × lets go. With handoff="pill" the count flies to the operation pill, which carries the result and Undo; an action that asks first says its consequence before it runs.

items.name: burn-up
items.title: Burn-up
items.description: Done climbs toward scope, a step line that rises the day work is added. From today a band tinted by health spans the days half and most of a forecast's runs finish, against the target. What moved the forecast can be written where it happened; read along by pointer or keys, with the forecast as it stood that day.

items.name: calendar-views
items.title: Calendar views
items.description: Meetings in time: a working week as columns of hours where a meeting drags to a new time or day in 15-minute hops, its foot drags its end and a drag down an empty day draws a block; a month of days; an agenda for a phone. Blocks wear the board card's look, a Signature edge on one tonal family.

items.name: cancel-flow
items.title: Cancel flow
items.description: One screen: what cancelling means (the plan stays until the day it ends, what is kept), then an optional question (why, one tap each, an optional note) that can bring the one alternative that fits beside Keep. The verb names the day (Cancel on 14 Nov) and works at once, never Are you sure. The host's billing cancels.

items.name: chat-kit
items.title: Chat kit
items.description: The stream's messages drive every part: your turns, each answer with its thinking and tools folded to one line, a call that asks holding its gate in its own row, the thumbs in its quiet actions, the box at the foot. Empty, it opens on one question and four asks. The agent's mark turns only while it works.

items.name: cited-note
items.title: Cited note
items.description: The coach's note on a glass card: the orb and when it was written, the reading in words in the display face at light weight (one or two lines on a phone), the why and the advice under it in the body face (`detail`), one action and one quiet second, and the one line that says what it read. It can be the page's heading.

items.name: cited-review
items.title: Cited review
items.description: On a glass card: the review in the display face, each number a value chip that opens what it rests on, the receipt of every source, what was left out, and one action. Beside it the split dots: mornings after the routine item lit, the rest hollow, both averages dashed. A table carries every morning.

items.name: column-map
items.title: Column map
items.description: Import's Columns step: each column of a file by its header, its first value, and what it becomes, from the host's list. A target belongs to one column at a time: giving it to another leaves the first out, and the map says so (the menu marks a target in use; a move writes one line). Only inside Import.

items.name: command-bar
items.title: Command bar
items.description: Say what you want in plain words and see what it will do first: the words turn into chips and one line says the consequence. Enter runs it, Tab completes, Esc clears. The host writes the verbs, so nothing is guessed.

items.name: comments
items.title: Comments
items.description: A task's conversation or a CRM record's notes: the first comment opens the thread, replies sit one step in. Each carries its reactions, @mentions as tokens and a link's preview; your own edits where it sits. Replies use the composer. Resolve draws its tick and folds the thread to one line: who closed it and how.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: The one box for a task's comment, a CRM note, a mail reply or a chat. At rest one quiet line with your portrait and the @; pressed, the tools ease in and it grows to six lines, then scrolls. @ names a person, stored by id; the face lands an emoji at the caret; Send is the one ink button, Send later on its split.

items.name: confirmation
items.title: Approval card
items.description: A step asked first, where the work is: the exact effect and the values it will run with, each changed in place (Restore puts it back) unless the app fixes it. Approve once, for the session or always, kept as a rule; a tool that deletes or leaves the app always asks, and a delete is held. Answered, it folds to one line.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: A chat in its own window: a floating title pill that opens its menu (Rename in place, then your verbs), your buttons at the top end, the turns top down in its own scroll with the earlier ones folded behind one divider, and the prompt at the foot.

items.name: cumulative-chart
items.title: Cumulative chart and bar list
items.description: One measure added up over a period, in the ink style: what happened a smooth line in the series hue over a fading area, the projection dotted, the comparison dashed, never colour alone. One dark card lists every series at a stop, from the pointer or the keyboard.

items.name: cumulative-flow
items.title: Cumulative flow
items.description: Each day, how many things sat in each state, stacked, so a widening middle band says work starts faster than it finishes. Each state is a soft tint of its own validated hue, named inside its band. Read along it by pointer or arrow keys and a dark pill lists that day's counts; the key writes them.

items.name: cycle-time-chart
items.title: Cycle time chart
items.description: How long work takes: how many things took each number of days from start to done, with the typical time and the time most finish within marked in plain words, every bar in one ink, and a line saying how many were counted and how many were left out because their start was never recorded.

items.name: data-table-extras
items.title: Data table extras
items.description: DataTable's opt-in parts, installed only by a table that uses them: columns in the person's order, rows in their own order, widths dragged at a header's edge, leading columns pinned, a header menu that sorts, pins, moves and fits, and a totals row. Each is passed in the table's parts.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A list of records with a sticky header, headers that sort their natural way first, rows that open on press and a selection column. The host owns the sort order, the selection and the row keys, so Shift-click runs or J, K, Enter and X match the rest of its app. A phone gets a calm list; parts: Data table extras.

items.name: deal-card
items.title: Deal card
items.description: Calm by default: who, worth, what and when, and the owner's face. It speaks up only when something needs you, in one line of words at most (no next step, overdue, stuck so many days), which replaces the close date.

items.name: deal-record
items.title: Deal record
items.description: One deal's page from the system's own pieces, with one primary. The header names the company, the stage, who is on it and who has it, then Send proposal and More. An agent's banner asks for an OK, then folds. Activity and Files are tabs; an agent's entry folds its steps; Files starts empty. Archive offers Undo.

items.name: delegate-flow
items.title: Delegate flow
items.description: One job handed to an agent on one card. The plan comes back as a draft you edit, then Approve plan. The same card runs it: a failed step waits on Retry, a step that sends outside waits in its row. Done, it folds to its result and a line that opens the changes, each with Undo; what can't be undone is said apart.

items.name: delete-workspace
items.title: Export and delete
items.description: Export everything as one action that makes the file and downloads it. Delete opens on that same export, made for you and shown done with Download, then asks for the workspace's name; the verb (Delete Notchset for good) waits for both. The host deletes; a refusal keeps the dialog and says why.

items.name: dependency-list
items.title: Dependency list
items.description: What a task waits on and what waits on it, across projects: each line the other task's glyph, key and title (a link that opens it) and where it stands, with a way to take a blocker off. Something outside the workspace is named in words; nothing either way says so in one line. The host passes its control for adding one.

items.name: digest
items.title: Digest
items.description: A summary of something long (a call, a thread, a week) that says what it will read before it spends anything; Summarise is the only way in. It writes what needs you first as next steps (what, by when, whose), then one paragraph of what was agreed, each cite mark opening its quote in place. Read, it folds to one line.

items.name: docked-assistant
items.title: Docked assistant
items.description: Beside a host's own page, the panel slides in as the page narrows on the same curve, so every edit lands in view. It says what it reads; its edits land on the page as hunks, counted kept and left, with Undo. Beside from 760px of its own width (its panel 320 to 400px as it widens); narrower, a sheet from the bottom.

items.name: document-to-record
items.title: Document to record
items.description: Any document to any record: an order form to a sales record, a lab report to results. Its fields fill in place beside the page (above it when narrow), so a smudged figure is checked against the page. Save waits on each unsure field. Saved, the dots leave, "you picked" stays, the file is attached, with Undo.

items.name: email-message
items.title: Email message
items.description: One message in a thread, flat like mail: who wrote it, who it went to, anyone it added, when, the words with their line breaks and its files as small tiles. Earlier messages fold to one quiet line so the latest is in reach.

items.name: email-preview
items.title: Email preview
items.description: The emails an app sends on its own (a receipt, a failed payment), as the reader sees them and written from the same numbers as the app: from and to, the subject, one paragraph, the facts, one button and the sender's address.

items.name: escalation-flow
items.title: Escalation flow
items.description: A support thread where the assistant answers what it can and offers a person beside its own next step. The hand-off is Transfer card; the person's words land with their photo; resolved says who and how long, then a one-tap rating with reasons. Steps fold as they finish, so it fits a 360px support widget.

items.name: express-pay
items.title: Express pay
items.description: Pay with a wallet where a card would otherwise be typed from scratch, drawn to the wallets' own rules. While the wallet's sheet is open the button says so and waits.

items.name: fact-strip
items.title: Fact strip
items.description: A record's key figures in one bordered row, each a label over its value. A value that can change is its own control and one that can't is plain text, so nothing looks pressable that isn't. Two to a row on a phone.

items.name: factor-rows
items.title: Factor rows
items.description: One row per contributor: the label on the left, the value on the right with one quiet line under it, the standing as a dot and a word and your usual in brackets. Five show and Show all opens the rest in place; no charts in the rows.

items.name: field-fill
items.title: Field fill
items.description: Paste text or drop a document and a form fills in place, one field at a time, each value with its Confidence dot as the header's count rolls. A focused field says where its value came from; one with two answers offers both as chips. The paste opens as a peek, the focused field's words lit. Undo empties the form.

items.name: figure-strip
items.title: Figure strip
items.description: The numbers that matter this period, each a button that opens the report behind it: the label, the figure, then what it means against something (a delta row), with a sparkline or meter for the glance. Tiles share hairlines; a headline figure can carry a table of facts (label and value rows, the delta last).

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: One grammar for every list. One Filter button opens the facets (F too); a pick is born as a chip out of the button, the count beside the list's name rolls and the rows that leave fold away. × or Backspace folds a chip; Clear all folds them back. No results names the filters with Remove and Clear all.

items.name: flow-journey
items.title: Flow journey
items.description: A numbered ink node per stage with its figure under it; what joined or left between stages hangs off the line on a dotted leader, a loss in the error colour's ink. The figures add up, and every step picks the records it counts. Still on arrival; Replay plays it once. Across when wide, down when narrow.

items.name: forecast-bar
items.title: Forecast bar
items.description: Where a number stands against its target in one line: won in the Done green, committed in the In review blue, best case hatched, a dashed tick for the target and a pin for the call. The figures are written beside it.

items.name: goal-plan
items.title: Goal plan
items.description: A goal becomes a team's plan: its work streams in with owner and estimate; what each waits for lights up on hover or focus. The ship date and its slack are worked out from the estimates and links, never from the model's words, and roll as you type. The rows it pushed wash once. Create lands them in order, with Undo.

items.name: header-actions
items.title: Header actions
items.description: The cluster at the end of an app's top bar: the page's icon actions (search, notifications), the theme switch and the account last, at one size and one gap so they read as one group. The host applies and saves the theme.

items.name: hero-orb
items.title: Hero orb
items.description: The Orb at hero size for a landing page: it plays a conversation as soon as it is seen, its light following a voice through a spring, then hands over at the first touch. Four knobs tune glow, grain, warmth and response. No sound; still with less motion.

items.name: import-review
items.title: Import review
items.description: Import's Review step for a document read into values: values that may be wrong first with an edit, a unit to resolve, one unread to type in or leave out; then the rest, with the printed range and how sure it is, folded to a count while some need you. Save keeps them as one step with Undo.

items.name: import
items.title: Import
items.description: One dialog of three steps (File, Columns, Review). File: a .csv or the host's sample, read in the browser. Columns: Column map. Review: rows that need you first, fixed in place or left out; duplicates skipped or added; then what will be made. A refusal keeps every fix with Retry; one Undo.

items.name: insight-card
items.title: Insight card
items.description: What this means in two sentences; what moves it as your own measured effects, label left and difference right, with one line on how they were measured; and the coach's tip as an object card on glass, cited, with one action.

items.name: intelligence-settings
items.title: Intelligence settings
items.description: A settings page for the model behind an app: the provider as a segmented control, the model as a select, the API key's status (the env var it lives in on the server, set or not, never the key), and a switch for each kind of data the model may read, with the count and one note. Memory goes after it.

items.name: invite-dialog
items.title: Invite dialog
items.description: Addresses as chips, the role in one tap with what it can do, and the join link: the role it gives, when it expires, Copy, how often it was used and Revoke. The footer counts the seats the invites take. Each change is one call on the host's adapter; a refusal keeps what you typed and says why.

items.name: knowledge-files
items.title: Knowledge files
items.description: Each file says honestly where it is: uploading with its share, reading with its pages so far, ready with what it read, or failed with a reason a person can act on and Retry. The cap is said once; drop files or choose them. The host uploads and reads.

items.name: line-items
items.title: Line items
items.description: What is being bought, one row per product: quantity, unit price, discount and the line's total. Values save as you type and the totals follow; a value it can't take stays in the field with the words to fix it.

items.name: live-activity-bar
items.title: Live activity bar
items.description: A run, a workout or a ride, live in an island at the top of a phone: compact, its clock and heart rate; pressed, it grows width then height to the run (distance, pace, the way to the goal, Pause and End) and folds back. Paused, the clock holds and the elapsed time leaves the pause out.

items.name: load-bars
items.title: Load bars
items.description: Each person's load against their usual pace, a short ink tick: a calm ok tint with Room for n under it, the warning colour and Full at it, the error colour and Over by n past it. The figures are written and each row is read as one sentence; LoadMeter is one alone, for a table cell.

items.name: load-error
items.title: Load error
items.description: Takes the page's place the moment its first load fails and stays until a Retry lands: the reason in words, Retry (busy while it runs; a failure keeps the panel with its new reason), a status page link and a mono line to quote (503 · unavailable · 10:42 · req id).

items.name: log-sheet
items.title: Log sheet
items.description: What, then the value (timed now), then what might explain it, as chips, ending on its receipt. A meal is its size and a note, Late on from 21:00; a GLP-1 dose is the medicine and dose as typed, never checked or suggested. Slips are caught; a refusal keeps what was typed. A sheet on a phone, a dialog on a desktop.

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: Logo wall
items.description: Integrations: the real marks in their own colours with their names, each a tab whose story plays in your panel beside it. Customers: lockups in one ink at full strength, drifting when the row overflows; hover or focus eases it to a stop and lifts that mark into its colours; Pause stops it.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric card
items.description: A wearable or logged measure today: value and unit, a slim bar of your baseline with today on it, one sentence of meaning and where and when it was measured. Designed states: no data with Connect, learning n of 14 nights, syncing, stale with Reconnect, outside your usual in words.

items.name: metric-trend
items.title: Metric trend
items.description: A value over time you scrub to read, against your usual or a lab's range, with the trend in words. A day with no data is a gap, never bridged; lab draws are dots joined by a dotted line; what you logged is written where it happened; too few points say so. Keys read every point.

items.name: movement-summary
items.title: Movement summary
items.description: What improved and what worsened since a point in time, each a signed total with how many records moved and a trend. It heads a waterfall; each side can pick the records behind it.

items.name: needs-you
items.title: Needs you
items.description: Home's lead block: the one thing that needs you now as a sentence with its action, quiet rows under it and how many are left today. Do it and the next row rises into its place; a waiting run is named by what it needs and answered here. Done greys with its tick, never struck. Off lead, the CRM's list.

items.name: next-step
items.title: Next step
items.description: The one task that moves a deal, read as a task you can tick. Ticking it pops, then asks for the next; with none set it says so and offers to add one from a line, a suggestion and a due chip.

items.name: no-access
items.title: No access
items.description: A page closed to your role: what can't be opened, one line naming who can give access, then Ask for access (it turns to Request sent) and the way back. Nothing of the page behind it shows, not even a count. It is an EmptyState (data-kind no-access).

items.name: not-found-scene
items.title: Not found scene
items.description: The 404 for a site or a playful product: a cat above Not found's page, drawn in the app's roles (coats in the slab, eyes in the Signature). A thread that lassos the way on you point at, a cat on the keys, or a cat that took the 0; the pages it likely meant sit above the way back.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not found
items.description: An address that isn't there (an old link, something deleted) said plainly in one line and never a dead end: the way back to the app's home and Search with its ⌘K, and the address that missed as a mono line to quote. It is an EmptyState (data-kind not-found), so it takes the page or section form by the space it is in.

items.name: notch
items.title: Notch
items.description: A rail set into the header where every agent run, send and timer is a segment showing its state, so the queue reads at rest. The one that speaks lifts out: a phase change peeks its words, a gate holds its card open with the exact action, a send keeps Undo. On a phone it floats as a pill at the foot.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification center
items.description: The bell in a top bar with its unread count. Pressed, one pop-out opens down: Mark all read, the tabs (All, Mentions, Assigned), then what happened by day, each unread row with one dot. Many updates on one record fold into a deck that fans open; new items wait above as a pill. On a phone it is the one bottom sheet.

items.name: notification-prefs
items.title: Notification preferences
items.description: What reaches you beyond the inbox: a preset per group (Everything, Only mine, Off) with a line saying what it adds up to; one group opens to a switch per event and channel. A daily summary and quiet hours sit under them; on a phone each event opens in place. A helper tells your sender now, later or never.

items.name: now-card
items.title: Now card
items.description: The one raised object on a list of work: a Now tag and why it's next, the task in the display face, where it belongs, and Mark done, Open and Later. Done fills the glyph and strikes the title; the host holds it a beat, then hands it the next task. With nothing left it says so as good news.

items.name: page-heading-fold
items.title: Page heading, folding
items.description: A record's head (a company, a deal, a project): trail, mark and name, facts, actions and tabs. As the page scrolls it folds into a 52px bar with the mark, the name, the tabs and the primary; scroll back and it opens. A tab's count rolls when something changes it.

items.name: panel-line
items.title: Panel line
items.description: The counts in three standings over a segmented bar, then every marker as an ink tick standing as tall as its value sits from the middle of its own range; out of range rise with a warn dot. Point to read one; the clinician's picks above. Plays a new panel's arrival.

items.name: people-directory
items.title: People directory
items.description: A directory of people over the records table: a search and a Team filter narrow it as you type and tick; each row shows the face, name and role, team, place and last seen. A press, or Enter on a name, slides the person panel in beside the table, which keeps its scroll; on a phone the panel takes the page.

items.name: pipeline-shapes
items.title: One pipeline, five shapes
items.description: The same deals as a board, a list, the forecast's stacks, a month of close dates and the people who own them. Each deal travels to its place in the next shape and the total never changes, because the facts don't.

items.name: plan-capsules
items.title: Plan capsules
items.description: Each focus area as a capsule: its status and window, the title, the tries for the one you're on (the row's flood), the markers it moves as plain label and value rows that open each, and a quiet retest line. The retest closes the row with its date, what is read again and one action.

items.name: plan-picker
items.title: Plan picker
items.description: The billing period, then the plans side by side: name, price per seat, what it adds and its limit, with the current plan marked. The period says the saving in words; picking a plan only picks it.

items.name: price-summary
items.title: Price summary
items.description: What a change costs before anything is confirmed: the seats times the price, any saving, then due today and from the next date. The totals roll when your choice moves them; a blocked change says why.

items.name: profile-page
items.title: Profile page
items.description: A person's or a company's page composed from parts you have: Record header (portrait or mark, name, one line of who, the actions), its figures without a box, and the page's tabs over Activity, deals, notes and files. The column is capped at 640px, so a wide screen keeps a reading measure.

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt suggestions
items.description: An empty chat's first asks in groups (Write, Plan, Analyse), each in a fixed frame of a 2×2 grid that names the tool it will use, so switching groups never moves the page: the cards crossfade in place. A press fills the box, ready to edit. As quiet rows, and below 480px. The coach's card keeps its three questions.

items.name: range-sources
items.title: Range sources
items.description: Two quiet columns: Ranges, each named with its numbers and who set it (the lab's printed range always among them), and Sources, each draw's date, value and the document it was read from. Provenance only, never a judgement.

items.name: reading-card
items.title: Reading card
items.description: One reading at work against its goal: the label and when it was read, the figure as a Rolling number (a new reading rolls only the digits that moved), its change, a one-part goal meter, and how far along and how much is left in words. It reads, it never edits: nothing on it changes the reading.

items.name: reading-pane
items.title: Reading pane
items.description: One conversation read like mail: the subject and its verbs, one line of people (faces, who to whom, how many, when) with Details opening the addresses in place, the linked item, the messages top down with the earlier ones behind one divider, and the reply box, the pane's one ring, at the foot.

items.name: reading-trio
items.title: Reading trio
items.description: Last night's three readings side by side: the label with its standing as a pill, the figure in the display face, and a flat range row against your usual, each opening its metric. On a phone they stack as rows with the standing word under the figure; a reading still learning its usual says so.

items.name: reason-prompt
items.title: Reason prompt
items.description: Asks why something just happened, at that moment, with one tap per reason and a Skip. The change is already made and the prompt never blocks it; the reason lives with the change in the record's history.

items.name: receipt
items.title: Receipt
items.description: Under a reply, one mono line: what answered, how long it thought, its sources and memories, and the lines nothing supports. Pressed, the full receipt: model and effort, how it was made (first word, speed, tokens, spend, rolling once), each source with its words, each memory, what it couldn't verify, and Copy.

items.name: record-body
items.title: Record body
items.description: A task in a side panel or on its page: its title edited in place, the one condition to act on as a banner with its fix, the property pills, details on demand, the description, the host's sections (subtasks, what it waits on, files) and the conversation. A refused save keeps the words.

items.name: record-details
items.title: Record details
items.description: A record's secondary column: a label-value list, then sections that fold, including who is involved and in what role. The host holds which sections are open, so it can remember them, and binds Esc beside the × that closes it. It stacks under the feed on a phone.

items.name: record-header
items.title: Record header
items.description: Who this record is: the mark or portrait, the name, one facts line, a sentence about it, and its actions with at most one primary. On a phone the actions move under the text.

items.name: remove-with-reason
items.title: Remove with reason
items.description: Marking a deal lost never stops you: it leaves the total at once and the row asks why, in place, one tap per reason or Skip. Undo puts it back exactly where it was and the total rolls back.

items.name: research-flow
items.title: Research flow
items.description: A research question as one page. The plan is a draft you edit, then Start; it folds to one line. A reading list fills a numbered row per source. The answer streams above it, a numbered cite mark popping as each sentence ends, its row lit, its passage on hover. Done, the list folds to one line; follow-ups wait.

items.name: result-list
items.title: Result list
items.description: Every result as a clean table: name, standing (Optimal, Normal, Out of range, or a flag), value and unit, the range bar cut flat, the change since last and the date. Grouped by system with out of range first, or by standing. A value that may be wrong says so inline with Edit. Compare puts two panels side by side.

items.name: result-summary
items.title: Result summary
items.description: Total, Optimal, Normal, Out of range (and To check) as counts over one segmented proportion bar; each count is a filter. The counts roll and the bar resizes when a new panel lands.

items.name: revenue-moved
items.title: Why revenue moved
items.description: One waterfall, several periods: pick a period and every bar slides to its new start and length on the shared scale, the end figure rolls, and the change is said in words. A step you picked stays picked.

items.name: row-actions
items.title: Row actions
items.description: A record's row, its mark, name and one detail line, with its actions at its end as small ghost icon buttons. A result shows in place: Share turns to a green tick and says Link copied, never a toast under the row; an archived row greys, is struck through and offers the way back.

items.name: rule-check
items.title: Rule check and ask tags
items.description: A thing measured against rules (a quote against the approval policy), one line per rule: the rule, its value and what it means. The icon and the words carry the state. Ask tags list only what needs someone.

items.name: run-kit
items.title: Run kit
items.description: One run drives every part: the pill in the header keeps its clock; the steps run under it, a tool call as its Tool row; the step that needs you grows its gate in its own row, and the pill offers the same answer, so either ticks both. At the end, the summary over the change set, checkpoints a press away.

items.name: run-list
items.title: Run list
items.description: Every background run in a row: its status, its name, one live line, its clock. A run that needs you rises to the top and says what it waits on, with Approve and Review in the row. The list never flashes: a waiting run glides up, and once approved glides back to its place. Open a run to see how it ended.

items.name: runs-kit
items.title: Runs kit
items.description: A tasks page for background agents: the run list, with the run that waits on you first and Approve in its own row, and the open run beside it: how it ended, its replay and its steps, a failed step with Retry. In a narrow window the side drops under the list. The kit adds only the split; every move is its parts'.

items.name: saved-memories
items.title: Saved memories
items.description: Each memory is its sentence and where it came from; the list stays open, five then Show all N. Press the words to edit in place; Add opens a fresh line. ✓ Saved only once the host answers; a refusal keeps your words with Retry. Forget folds the row with Undo (⌘Z). Switched off, it stays, quieter.

items.name: schedule-list
items.title: Schedule list
items.description: Each routine is a sentence (what, when, where it reports), its next run and its last result in one line with one dot: found something, quiet, failed; the line opens its report. Run now and a switch show on hover or focus; Run now turns the line live, then rolls it. A new one is typed in words, read back as parts.

items.name: scrub-chart
items.title: Scrub chart
items.description: One figure over time against a target, in the chart family's ink style. Drag across it or use the arrow keys and the headline rolls to that point, with how far it sits from the target in words, while a halo and a dark pill follow you. The last point is where it rests.

items.name: search-results
items.title: Search results
items.description: A search page: the field on top, facets with live counts down the side, the results in the middle and the chosen one read on the end edge. Typing filters live with the words in bold ink; ticking a facet narrows them and the other counts follow. Arrow keys move the one wash and the preview follows; Enter opens.

items.name: session-rows
items.title: Session rows
items.description: One row per session: when, what, how long, how far, the average heart rate and a thin bar of its minutes by zone in the zone ramp. On a phone the distance and heart rate fold away and the zones run under the name. With an href each row opens its session.

items.name: settings-layout
items.title: Settings layout
items.description: A list of sections beside the open one, each made of groups of rows: what the setting does on the left, its control on the right, taking effect as it changes. On a phone the list comes first.

items.name: share-link
items.title: Share link
items.description: Choose the panels, trends and logs to share and see the page the clinician reads, with what's included said in words. Share a PDF or a link that expires in 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days and can be revoked; an expired or revoked link says so and offers a new one. The host makes the link.

items.name: share-view
items.title: Share this view
items.description: The Share pill opens into the panel it was hiding, in place: copy the link, pick who can open it, add people and Send. A sent share folds back into a pill that says who has it; a failed one keeps everything and offers Retry.

items.name: sheet-grid
items.title: Sheet grid
items.description: Records in a grid: arrows, Home and End move the current cell, Enter edits a text cell or opens a cell's picker, Esc puts it back, Tab steps across, Shift+Enter opens the row. The first column stays put, headers sort, their edges resize (or Alt and an arrow), and a row unfolds its children in place.

items.name: showcase-wall
items.title: Showcase wall
items.description: The live pieces a homepage leads with, each big and touchable on a soft wash, with its name and what happens when you touch it underneath. Tiles mount as they come near the screen and hold their place.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Parts an app writes its navigation from: Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarSearch, SidebarSection, SidebarItem and SidebarFooter (you). One raised pill glides to the page you're on and into the rail; a folded section says how many it hides. WorkspaceSwitcher flies the picked workspace's mark into place.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in and onboarding step
items.description: Two ways in: a link proves the inbox and sets up a workspace; a passkey goes straight into an account you already have. Then check your email, or confirm it's you. The onboarding step asks one question per screen. `personal` drops the work wording and single sign-on for a consumer app (Health).

items.name: signed-form
items.title: Signed form
items.description: A small order form that ends in a signature: draw it, with Undo and Clear, or type your name. Signing flips the deal to Won and the Signature traces the card once; a refused signature keeps the ink and offers Retry. A line marked one-time is totalled apart: recurring per year, one-time and the first year.

items.name: source-row
items.title: Source row
items.description: A provider, what it brings and when it last synced, with its state in a word and the one action for it: connected, syncing with how far, learning your baseline, stale with Reconnect, refused with the reason and Try again, or disconnected with what's kept.

items.name: sources
items.title: Sources
items.description: Where an answer's claims come from. Under an agent's answer, cards: live they hold the slots they'll fill (3 of 8), finished a card shows its passage on a short rest and lights its cite marks, and one you can't open says so, never its words. Under a research answer, a list whose chips open each passage.

items.name: stage-checklist
items.title: Stage checklist
items.description: What a step usually needs before it moves on, ticking itself as each thing comes true, and saying "Ready to move on" at the end. A soft gate: it informs and never blocks.

items.name: stage-table
items.title: Stage table
items.description: One row per stage: the share that moved on of those that left, how many sit past the stuck threshold, how many were lost, and the typical (median) days. Rows keep the pipeline's order until a header is pressed.

items.name: stage-totals
items.title: Stage totals
items.description: Each stage's worth as a bar in its own colour, with the figure and how many deals; each row opens that stage. The footer is one even line of facts.

items.name: status-island
items.title: Status island
items.description: A small dark island at the top of a screen that reshapes to hold what just happened: a call coming in, a file going up, a thing done. The shape changes first and the words arrive a beat after.

items.name: status-line
items.title: Status line
items.description: Home's first line: who you are greeted as, then the few facts that say how today looks, each a link to its page, joined by dots. A period switch sits on the right.

items.name: step-rail
items.title: Step rail
items.description: An automation top to bottom, what starts it, then each step, on a quiet rail. Test runs it: each step's status glyph turns and ticks in turn, and what it gave folds open in one line under it, so the rail grows down; the finish ticks the head once. A failure keeps its place, its cause in the service's words, with Retry.

items.name: stepped-setup
items.title: Stepped setup
items.description: A first run in a few steps as one card: a rail of ink steps at its start (done ones go back), the step's title, one line and its rows, then Back, Skip and Continue; under 640px a line over a bar per step. Continue is never disabled: a refused step says why. Finish ends on a done state.

items.name: suggested-reply
items.title: Suggested reply
items.description: A reply the agent drafted, one line above your reply box with Insert at its end. Open it to read it in full and steer: three short answers, Warm or Direct, Shorter, Redraft; each rewrite streams in place. Insert is the only bridge to your box, never one key from Send; inserted, the line folds and says so.

items.name: target-drop
items.title: Target drop
items.description: A few deals in their stages over the quarter's progress toward quota. Move a card and everything that depends on it answers: the totals roll, the bar moves, and crossing quota sweeps the ring once. A refused save goes home with Retry.

items.name: task-calendar
items.title: Task calendar
items.description: A month of work on the calendar's grid: each day's tasks as chips (done struck through, late with the error colour's edge), the first three then more in place. Drag a chip to another day or focus it and press Shift and an arrow; a refused move springs back and a moved chip keeps focus. On a phone a day shows dots.

items.name: task-card
items.title: Task card
items.description: A task on a board answering three things at a glance: what it is (the title and labels), whether something is wrong (one flag line in words) and who and when (its key, priority, marks, due date and assignee). A lens dims the cards that don't match. It carries the board's card id, so the Board drags and moves it.

items.name: task-list
items.title: Task list and quick add
items.description: Tasks grouped by when (Overdue, Today, This week, Later), each row the Task row. A folded group still says how many and names the first two. A tick draws, the row holds a beat and folds away; right-click opens its menu at the pointer, H and ⌫ act on the focused row, a phone swipes. Quick add reads the line into chips.

items.name: task-row
items.title: Task row
items.description: One task on one line: its status glyph (which finishes it), the title with its small marks, then only the columns the page doesn't already say, and when it's due, late in the error colour. Selection is plain, the keyboard's row ringed in ink; the host binds J, K, X and Enter.

items.name: team-attainment
items.title: Team attainment
items.description: Each seller's quarter against quota as a meter and a figure, in the order you pass them; a met quota shows its figure in the ok colour (the bar stays ink, since green means won elsewhere). Each row opens that seller's records.

items.name: test-card
items.title: Test card
items.description: A test's name and lab on frosted glass, a five-step line (Ordered, Sample taken, At the lab, Reading, Ready) with the spinner on the live step, and when it's ready what was read and the one action.

items.name: test-progress-card
items.title: Test progress card
items.description: The test and its lab with a pill for where it is, one sentence of what came back, the draw date and what was measured, then five steps with the current one lit, and one action. Where results arrive it takes the prismatic edge, which sweeps once when a new set lands.

items.name: thread-list
items.title: Thread list
items.description: Conversations, newest first: who, their company, when, the subject and the first line; unread is bold with a dot. On a desktop ↑ ↓ walk it, H snoozes and E archives, and hover shows read, Snooze and Archive; on a phone a thread swipes. A thread taken out closes its gap, and Undo glides it back.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: When work runs, as bars on days by milestone, each task's glyph, title and owner beside its bar. The bars are one tonal family, so today's line is the one Signature mark. A dragged bar lifts and snaps day to day, its dates rolling; an end drags one date; a refused move springs back.

items.name: today-agenda
items.title: Today's agenda
items.description: The day's meetings by time with a hairline at now. Past meetings fade, the next one offers Join, and each opens its panel. The company's mark is the only colour.

items.name: tool-permissions
items.title: Tool permissions
items.description: The tools an agent may use, grouped by server with a switch for each. A tool says what it does and its context cost, with Ask or Allow; one that pays, deletes or sends outside always asks. Under them, the rules Always allow made: each opens the gate that made it, and Remove has Undo.

items.name: tool
items.title: Run steps
items.description: A turn's calls on Tool rows under one line: "Using 3 tools" while they run, the apps' marks stacking as each joins; a call that asks holds it open with its gate in its row, and 450ms after the last call it folds to "Used 3 tools · 3 calls". A run's steps can still read as a timeline that folds to one line.

items.name: top-bar
items.title: Top bar
items.description: The 48px band over a page and nothing else: its first child names the page, said once, and takes the room; what follows sits at the end, with at most one primary, last. Its hairline shows only once the page scrolls under it; on a phone a labelled button after the name shows only its icon.

items.name: upgrade-card
items.title: Upgrade card
items.description: Near the limit it says what's left and when it resets; at it, the two ways on: Upgrade, with what the next plan adds, or Send when it resets, which keeps the message and says when it goes. Compare plans opens the plan picker in place. The host owns the checkout.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: Two windows, this one and this week, each with its share and its reset written beside a bar that warns from 75%. Folded in, how long this chat is, without token talk. As a line it shows in the composer only under 20% left. With no plan it says it doesn't measure.

items.name: verify-email
items.title: Verify email
items.description: A strip on the Account page, not a page of its own: which address waits and what waits with it, six cells that take a typed, pasted or phone-filled code and check it on the sixth digit, a new code counted down, and Change email. A wrong code says so and clears.

items.name: voice-strip
items.title: Voice strip
items.description: Above the composer while you talk: the live orb (its edge your voice, its body the reply's), what's happening in words that instruct, and the live caption. Mute and End are always there. Captions carry it with the sound off; a refused microphone says how to allow it.

items.name: waterfall
items.title: Waterfall
items.description: Why a number changed: the start, each step that added or took away, and the end, every bar on one scale so a step's length is its size. Signs and colour together, never colour alone; steps with nothing in them share one quiet line.

items.name: webhook-list
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: The addresses a workspace sends events to: the host first, how many events, whether it works and how the last delivery went. Only a failing one is tinted. The endpoint dialog takes an https address and the events, grouped.

items.name: workspace-admin
items.title: Workspace admin
items.description: Who is in a workspace and what each can change, as tabs with counts: Members with a role select per row, a bar that changes every ticked role at once and a tally by role; Guests with what a guest sees; Invites with expiry, Send again and Revoke; allowed Domains. Each change is one adapter call.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action button
items.description: One press that runs a task and says how it went, in place, calm: Send crossfades to the spinner and Sending…, then the green tick and Sent or a rose ring and Retry; Delete acts at once, says Deleted and offers Undo for 5s; Upload keeps its well, the ring filling with the real figure, and turns it green.

items.name: action-swap
items.title: Action swap
items.description: OpenBot's compact toggle that says its state in words (Watch, Watching): the small outline button, both words in one cell so the width never jumps, crossfading. On, the chosen fill; icon and pressedIcon swap too. Busy, the icon is the spinner; a refusal keeps it as it was and says why.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: How often something happened: one tile a day on one even grid, shaded by the data ramp, months over their first week; the total on one line, the streak and a key below. Pointer or arrows light a day and its week; with `readout` the line reads it and a press selects one day; `size="fit"` fills the width.

items.name: actor-tag
items.title: Actor tag
items.description: Who made a change, a run or a version, told by shape before name: a person is a circle (photo or initials), the agent a rounded square in the viewer's Signature with its four-point mark, a subagent the same mark in outline on the tint, named with whom it works for ("Enricher for Assistant"). Sized as the avatar.

items.name: avatar-card
items.title: Avatar card
items.description: A square ID card for one person: their photo large, name and designation on the front. Press it and it turns over in 3D to their team and place, two or three figures and an address; press again and it turns back. A turned corner at rest, and a lean toward its turn on hover or focus, say it turns.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar stack
items.description: Who is on something: avatars overlapping, each cut out of the surface by a ring of it, then "+N". It reads out as one phrase: "Ana Ruiz, Kevin Ito and 3 more".

items.name: avatar-upload
items.title: Avatar upload
items.description: Choose, drop or paste a photo; one over 5 MB or not a PNG, JPEG or WebP is refused in words. Crop it in place: the circle is the face; drag, the arrow keys or the zoom rail. Save hands it to the host, whose progress fills a ring. A refusal keeps the old face everywhere. look="lands" flies it into where it shows.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo, or their initials in a luminous aurora of three hues drawn from their name, sized to the row it sits in. In a row it opens the person card (hover, focus or a press); standing alone, it says the name on hover and focus. An AI wears one of our three drawn characters, never a photo.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A word on a soft wash of its colour. Four forms: dot (status in rows, the default), open (a label), code (mono: invoice.paid, 404) and ended (over: no wash, a hollow dot). A change glides; into Won a green burst. value is the count form: an ink pill, 99+. Tones neutral, signal, info, ok, warn, bad.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Something about this page to know before acting ("Close date passed 3 days ago"): the fact in bold, the reason, then at most one fix, on a white card whose mark carries the tone. Two or more in one place are one BannerGroup panel, worst first, three shown, then "Show N more".

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A value per period as columns in soft tints of the series hue; one is the focus, lit with the one glow under it (at rest the latest complete period). A period so far is hollow; a reference line names a goal or the average; `litOnly` figures the lit bar alone; stacked draws several series in one ramp.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar list
items.description: Ranked rows (pipeline by stage, revenue by source): the name, a bar to scale against the largest and its figure, with a quieter count after it. Bars rest at the series' soft tint; the row you point at or focus lights in the series hue with the list's one glow. With href or onSelect each row opens what it ranks.

items.name: baseline-meter
items.title: Baseline meter
items.description: Samples fill in ink as each is measured, the count written (9 of 14) and what's left, so nothing is read against a usual that doesn't exist yet; full, it becomes the band with the latest value on it. For an HRV baseline over nights, a new store's sales over days, a sensor calibrating.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom sheet
items.description: A phone's place for a short set of choices or a small form: it rises with a grab handle and closes by swiping down, tapping outside or Esc. peek opens it at half height; a second step slides in inside it (Esc steps back); with 600px of room it is a dialog.

items.name: brand-lockup
items.title: Brand lockup
items.description: The product's own brand, drawn one way in every template: the plus in the Signature, then the lowercase wordmark in ink, in three sizes. A buyer swaps their name and mark in one place. Customer companies are a different thing (company mark).

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb and back
items.description: Where this page sits, said once in the top bar: quiet parent links, then the page's title. On a phone the parents give way to one Back to the nearest parent, so the bar never wraps.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The one action shape, calm: it changes colour only. Secondary (a tonal wash) by default, one primary per region, outline, ghost, danger (a soft rose wash), link. Busy is built in: its words crossfade to busy and a CSS ring turns while presses are ignored. Done or failed: ActionButton; a hold: HoldToConfirm.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: The grid every date picker shares. Press the title for the months, again for the years (one list that scrolls). A pick blooms the chosen disc from the day's dot and settles; a day set from outside brings its month into view. `marked` days carry a dot; `preview` washes a day before it is picked.

items.name: capability
items.title: Capability
items.description: What the backend can do decides what is drawn. A capability it doesn't declare hides the control (no button, shortcut or command); one unavailable right now (offline, rate-limited) is drawn disabled, its reason on hover, focus and tap. can() and unavailable() for keys.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: MediaCard: a photo-led card for a thing you choose by its look. Plain (inset picture, concentric corners) or immersive (the picture fills it); swipe its photos and the hue follows; its one action rolls a count. Card is a section of a page: a header with a count and one link, a footer of facts.

items.name: celebrate-button
items.title: Celebrate button
items.description: A calm button for a rare win: it waits on its work with a spinner and its busy words, then lands with the green tick and its result while a burst leaves the button: confetti (the default), fireworks or streamers, one per product. A failure rings it rose and says Retry. Every state keeps one size.

items.name: change-hunks
items.title: Change hunks
items.description: A proposed change to one text, read in place: removed words struck in a quiet ink, new words beside them on the Signature's fading wash. Keep and Undo show beside a hunk on hover or focus, a foot counts what's left with Undo all and Keep all (Mod+Enter). Text stream in while written; a failed hunk says why, with Retry.

items.name: change-set
items.title: Change set
items.description: What a run changed across records or files, one row each: the record, its change in one line (field: before → after), who made it, Undo. Rows grow in as changes land. An undone row keeps its place with Redo, never struck. The foot keeps the rest (Keep N) or undoes all; kept, it names who kept it.

items.name: chart-delta
items.title: Chart delta
items.description: The signed change beside a figure (“▲ +29%”, “▲ +2 days”): a drawn ▲ or ▼ and the figure in the ok or bad ink by what it means, never by its sign, then what it is measured against in grey. No chip or tint. deltaOf reads a change by its better direction. Uses: a hero figure, a card against last week, a list row.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Set variant bars, stack or line with stops and series and it draws the whole chart, at a density: hero (edge to edge, the latest value pinned, first and last dates) or analytic (y-axis values, three hairlines, every date). A smooth line over a fading area, a pill following the pointer or keys, a table of each point.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: 16px: a softly rounded square in a form, or round (variant round) for completing something, popping once; checked, it fills with the Signature. Children are its label, hint a quieter line; disabled reads its reason there, error says what is wrong.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: Each item is a tick, an optional planned time, the item and one quiet line: your note, who ticked it or the pick. With no times the next row's end holds its one action, so a setup list sits on it. A note is added in place. One light glides to the next row; the count lands with your tick; no streaks or badges.

items.name: checkpoint-rail
items.title: Checkpoint rail
items.description: Oldest at the top, now at the bottom; a mark grows in as the run passes it. Pick one: a well opens with Content, Chat or Both, the count of what restores and Restore, and the marks the choice would cost dim. A restore is itself a mark, with what it put back and Undo, so going back is never a loss.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip group
items.description: Pills that pick what applies: tags (tonal, the check slot opening as the check draws), a pick-one filter (solid ink, counts in a fixed slot), Scout's dashed suggestions accepted in one press. "+N more" unfolds in place; a new chip grows in as the rest glide; loading reads in from bones.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: One chip in three forms: a tag you press on (look tonal: an ink wash, its check slot opening as the check draws), a pick-one filter's current (look solid, its count in a tabular slot), or Scout's suggestion (dashed, his orb, an x; a press adds it). A removable value folds away when removed.

items.name: choice-toggle
items.title: Choice toggle
items.description: Picks a plan, Free or Premium, and how Premium is billed: an ink thumb that glides with no stretch or overshoot and can be dragged; on Premium it splits into Monthly and Yearly with a green 20% off. The price crossfades. ChoiceTabs is its calm second look: sliding tabs on a quiet bar.

items.name: cite-mark
items.title: Cite mark
items.description: The small raised number a claim carries. Pressing it lights its source; the source lights it back (the host passes lit while its card is pressed, hovered or focused), and lit washes its claim in the Signature's tint. Rest and lit, a colour change only; a toggle named by its source, Escape puts it out.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: A one-time code in its own cells: each cell is the phone field's well at 44. One real input carries it, so the phone offers it and a paste fills every cell. A wrong code shakes and clears for retyping; a right one turns the cells green and says Verified. The quiet key counts down to Resend code. Looks: plain, and show.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color picker
items.description: One soft card that rests open. A large area picks how clear and how bright, its knob lifting a loupe when pressed; a hue rail, an opacity rail, a hex field that answers as you type, the eyedropper where the browser has one, and eight recent colours. The chip says how each kept colour reads as text on the surface.

items.name: column-fill
items.title: Column fill
items.description: A Grid's column, filled row by row from one instruction. The header carries the instruction and a line that grows with the cells settled. Each cell ends as a value with its source, an unsure value with Review, a failure with Retry, or not found. Settled, the header folds to one line: "HQ city · 6 filled · 1 to review".

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Pick one of a long list by typing: the first match is highlighted, so type then Enter picks it. It says "No matches", never an empty box. label, hint and error put it in a Field. Two looks: clean lists names only; detailed gives each row its detail and recency, recent ones first.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command palette
items.description: The centred ⌘K palette over a dimmed page: go anywhere or do anything by typing. Results are grouped, the first match is chosen, arrows move and Enter runs it. Each typed word matches the start of a word in a label or its keywords: matched letters ink in, missed rows fold away; nothing found says so.

items.name: company-mark
items.title: Company mark
items.description: A company's colour as a rounded square with its initial or its glyph. The colour is the company's own data, the one place a component takes a raw colour. In a row it previews the company (Company card, the person card's family): name, domain, up to three related items the app passes in.

items.name: confidence-dot
items.title: Confidence dot
items.description: A dot and a word that always go together: filled for Sure, half for Check, a ring for Unsure, so it reads in greyscale and to a screen reader. Check and Unsure take the warn hue, never red: nothing failed. Unsure never acts on its own; the host leaves it out of the bulk action and offers Review.

items.name: context-meter
items.title: Context meter
items.description: A ring by Send, three arcs in the grid's tones (system and tools, files, conversation) with the free room as its track; past 90% the track turns warn and the figure shows. Opened, the ring unrolls into a grid of a hundred cells in the same order, with Compact, which dims the conversation oldest first.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: The one copy control, calm: its icon crossfades to the still green tick and Copy to Copied, colour only, read once, at a width held by the widest word. Refused, it says the rose Not copied and selects the value to copy by hand. As a button in a field, or the icon alone, its name and tip saying Copied.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A due date or a close date: shortcuts beside a calendar, so it fits the window; pointing at one washes its day in the month before you press. Or type it ("nov 3", "next fri", "11 3") and read it back before Enter takes it. A new date clears onto the field; a phone gets a bottom sheet.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A report's period. Presets first, each with its dates written out, or press a start and an end on the calendar. The trigger says the range in words; Esc mid-pick keeps the old range.

items.name: day-states
items.title: Day states
items.description: Load rises above a hairline (stressed tall in the series hue, engaged short and lighter), restoring dips below it in grey and calm is the hairline. Gaps stay empty; minutes per state sit under it. `scrub` reads one stretch at a time; `baseline` stands every state on one line over a calm track.

items.name: day-timeline
items.title: Day timeline
items.description: Wearable events, logs and routine ticks on one day axis, solid up to now and dotted after, with Now as the one lit mark. Six entries at most, View the day for the rest; a list on a phone. `head` adds a row naming the day and its entry count, with View the day at its end.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: One focused step: a title that says it, a line that says what happens, the form, then Cancel and the one verb, rightmost. A dangerous verb says what it destroys and is red. Enter runs it from a field; a sheet on a phone.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: A heading that shows or hides what is under it: a turning chevron, the name, a quiet reading at the end, the panel growing into place. In a group (the accordion) arrows walk the headings; one panel opens at a time, or several with multiple. A custom trigger uses useDisclosure.

items.name: dot-picker
items.title: Dot picker
items.description: Seven nights as dots with each day and figure: hollow when below your usual, the chosen night ringed and lit. A radio group: arrow keys, Home and End move and choose, and each dot says its night in words (`labels` translates them).

items.name: draw-history
items.title: Draw history
items.description: A segmented standing bar (low, in range, optimal, in range, high) with the latest value haloed on it and the draw before as a hollow ring; under it every draw as a large dated dot with its value on a calm line, over the optimal band and the lab's lower limit, and the planned retest as a dotted ring at its date.

items.name: email-field
items.title: Email field
items.description: A Text field typed as email that catches a typo in a common mail domain: on leaving it, or after a pause, the hint line asks "Did you mean maya@gmail.com?" with Use it, which puts the fix in place. Only near misses of common domains are offered, never a company's own.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji picker
items.description: Any emoji while replying or reacting, in the system's own emoji. It opens with the focus in its search; Frequently used leads, the rail at the foot jumps to a category and follows the scroll, the hovered emoji is named with its shortcode and the hand sets the skin tone. A pick closes it and hands the host where it was.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What goes here and the one way to fill it. A page-sized one centres a title, a line and an action; inline, it is the quiet line inside a section ("No notes yet").

items.name: expandable-text
items.title: Expandable text
items.description: A long description folds to a few lines with Show more under it, and only when it is really cut. Show less folds it back and keeps your reading place; the whole text stays in the page for search and screen readers.

items.name: expanding-button-group
items.title: Expanding button group
items.description: A row of icon keys acting on one thing (a post, a file). The key you reach opens its name; a press turns its icon into the done mark and the done word crossfades in. The group reserves its widest width, the bar centred in it, so the row never moves. Plain ships in an app; Spring labels and Fan are showpieces.

items.name: expanding-button
items.title: Expanding button
items.description: One create button (New) that opens into its few kinds. Unfold, in place: the plus turns to a close mark as the kinds rise beneath it on a spring; choose one and it slides home under New, turns green with its result, then the set drops away and focus returns to New. Menu: a small menu of the kinds under New.

items.name: expanding-search
items.title: Expanding search
items.description: A search icon for a crowded toolbar or a phone header. A press opens it into the field, growing into the slot its host keeps for it, so what sits beside it never moves. Esc or leaving folds it: empty, back to the icon; with a query, into a chip on the icon that keeps it, reopens the field, and clears with ×.

items.name: explain
items.title: Explain
items.description: "What is this?" where the word is: a quiet ? opens two sentences on what a term means, what counts and what doesn't, and one link to Help. It opens on a press: the term's underline draws and the card blooms under it. Show me folds it and lets the page light the rows that make the figure. The bottom sheet on a phone.

items.name: facet-list
items.title: Facet list
items.description: A search's filters as checkbox rows, each with how many results ticking it gives within the current query. As the query changes the counts roll, one row a beat after the one above; a facet at 0 dims in place and can't be ticked; rows never reorder. Groups stack under quiet names; ticks are the Signature's.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label above a control, then a hint or the error, read together. An error marks the control invalid. It also gives every text control the same recessed well and the ink hairline on focus.

items.name: file-drop
items.title: File drop
items.description: Choose files, drop them or paste them. Each is checked against the types, size and count it takes, and one that doesn't fit is named with its reason; the rest are listed with their size while the prompt folds to a slim Add more. Uploading and progress are the upload block's, which composes this.

items.name: filter-button
items.title: Filter button
items.description: One facet of a list (Stage, Owner): dashed until used, then knit solid from where you pressed it, its menu open as you tick several. Or FilterMenu, one Filter button for all the facets: a facet drills in place, Left goes back, Esc closes; each value counts what it would leave. The filter bar gives each pick its chip.

items.name: flood-tile
items.title: Flood tile
items.description: A page's key figure on the Signature's gradient, grain on top, white type that passes AA, a fine arc or ruler drawn large; the standing rides on it as a white pill. One per page. With drift its light moves over about 52 s, paused when hidden or off screen and still under reduced motion.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: A spreadsheet, keyboard first. The cursor is the Signature ring alone and slides; Shift+arrows or a drag grow a range under one wash; the corner handle fills down. Enter or typing edits on the float shadow, Esc rolls the old value back. Copy, paste and Delete work on a range; headers sort and resize.

items.name: help-dialog
items.title: Help dialog
items.description: The app's own help: Find a word at the top (focused), then a row a word with its meaning on one line; a row opens the whole meaning and what counts and what doesn't, one at a time. Matched letters show in ink. The footer goes to the keys and to support. On a phone the meaning moves under its word.

items.name: help-menu
items.title: Help menu
items.description: Help where people look for it, one group in one order in every app: Keyboard shortcuts (?), Help centre (F1) and Contact support, in the account menu at the column's foot. Theme is three choices in its row; Sign out waits on the server. A part left unset isn't drawn; HelpMenuItems puts the same group in any Menu.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: A step that cannot be undone, confirmed by holding. The hold fills from the start edge as a sweep, a line traced round the edge, or Hold 3, 2, 1. Danger is rose with the bin; primary (Publish to production) fills with ink, its own icon in front. An assistive press asks in a dialog, Cancel first.

items.name: hue-mesh
items.title: Hue mesh
items.description: A soft pastel mesh of one of the family's category hues over frosted white (deep and glowing in dark), entering from the same top-left corner on every tile. Identity, never standing.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: OpenBot's ghost square holding one icon: 30, 36 or 44, the glyph 14, 16 or 18, ink on the hover wash. Its label is required: the name and the tip above, with its key. A toggle says its state by its glyph (filled, or pressedIcon); a result swaps in the green tick and says it in the tip.

items.name: image-resolve
items.title: Image resolve
items.description: One image, or four as a 2x2 at the target ratio,; the layout never moves. Each starts as a soft field of the colours that have arrived; tiles gather onto it from the centre out as real progress lands, never on a timer. At done the sharp picture opens from the centre in one ripple; a failed one shakes and Retries alone.

items.name: inline-complete
items.title: Inline complete
items.description: A text area that offers the rest of your sentence in quiet grey at the caret, never a box, so your words never move. It comes after a pause, only at the end of the text. Tab takes it, Mod+Right one word (hold it and the words step to ink), Esc lets it go. What you take is typed in, so Mod+Z puts it back.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: A value you change where you read it. With format money, count or date it reads shorthand (52k, 1.2m, next fri, dec 12), says what it saves as while you type and saves the tidy form; minBusy holds a quick save busy. A refusal says why and keeps your words; a failed save lets Enter try again.

items.name: keyboard-hint
items.title: Keyboard hint
items.description: Keycaps for a shortcut ("⌘K", or G then S), ⌘ on Apple and Ctrl elsewhere. Each cap sinks as its key goes down; tone ok lights the chord green left to right when it ran. Size lg teaches the key on its own. Hidden on touch screens. The shortcut must work: a printed key nobody bound is a bug.

items.name: light-field
items.title: Light field
items.description: A wide soft wash of the Signature's light entering from the top right and fading before the page's lower half; in dark it becomes an edge light from the right. Never an orb shape, grain on top, one per page, decoration only.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: One smooth line in the series hue over a fading wash, the period before a dashed quiet ghost, one glow on the point you read. Hero is a glance (edge to edge, latest pinned); analytic reads values. `annotation` marks one event; `scale` keeps round y values in the hero.

items.name: line-figure
items.title: Line figure
items.description: A hairline figure in ink at 70%, its construction lines dotted: nested circles converging (a receipt), two cones meeting (an approval), a wireframe cube (contained), or your own shapes. It draws in once on entering view, then holds still; with less motion, or `still` (a small figure), it is simply there.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link preview
items.description: A pasted link as a small card: the company's own mark, the page's title in ink, the site and section in grey, no image banner. It unfolds from the link's line to its height while the words cross-fade, and folds back; two quiet buttons fold it or remove it. While the host reads the page the title shimmers once.

items.name: live-label
items.title: Live label
items.description: Work in the tense of where it stands: present while it runs, a soft ink sweep across the words (never the Signature); past tense in ink when it ends, the outcome after it in ink-3, or what failed in the danger ink. Both tenses share one cell, so the line never shifts: one crossfade with a 2px rise.

items.name: mention-field
items.title: Mention field
items.description: @-mentions in a comment, a note or a description. Typing @ opens the people under the @, narrowing as you type (matches in bold); Enter lands a token stored by the person's id, so a rename never breaks it. Backspace selects a token, then removes it whole. MentionText draws a sent value with each token a link.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: The actions for a thing, opened from a button.
