Rows carry an icon and the shortcut the app binds, light in ink under the pointer, and the number keys run the first nine; group labels name a set, and the one destructive step is said in words and red. Rows as parts or as items. A bottom sheet on a phone.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A reply drawn from its parts in the order they came: text through Stream text, thinking folded, tool calls as Tool rows, and sources, files, a plan or a question through the host's own map. Stop keeps what it wrote (Continue, Try again); it says Still working after 8 s and names what answered. Versions sit in place.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: How much is used or done, as a thin bar beside the number that says it. Progress fills in the series hue, or ok (tone ok) for good news; usage warns from 75% and turns bad when full, in words ("2 left", "Full"). Size lg is the full meter: parts and a legend, over (the max ticked, the excess hatched) and unlimited.

items.name: model-selector
items.title: Model selector
items.description: Up to four choices named by purpose, each with when to pick it, the model's name and its price and speed line; no hidden Auto. With effort, one pill names model and effort and the menu offers effort under the models. One that can't answer now stays listed with why; a fixed model shows who set it. ModelDetail compares.

items.name: money-input
items.title: Money input
items.description: An amount in any currency: typed once and settled into the currency's form when the field is left, stepped with the arrows. The value is held in the currency's minor units (4800 is $48.00), never a float. The amount changes in place; it never rolls. It is Number field's money form.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Pick several from a short, known list. The picks sit in the field as chips on one line, the rest counted "+N", and a picked row's mark travels into its chip. Each row can say how it acts. Clear sits beside the field. On a phone the list is the bottom sheet.

items.name: nav-pill-menu
items.title: Nav pill menu
items.description: The anchored Menu for a plain Nav pill's folded links, the current page checked. Nav pill ships without it (its own fold drops a plain list from the pill), so a site that wants the full Menu (arrow keys through the rows, type-ahead, the menu's own open and close) passes NavPillMenu as the pill's menu.

items.name: nav-pill
items.title: Nav pill
items.description: A site's header in one floating bar, two looks. Plain (the default): mark, links and one ink call to action; the current link's wash and ink bar glide to a pick; folded, Menu drops the links from the pill (or opens Nav pill menu). Island: one slab whose bridges pull as the pointer crosses.

items.name: new-items-pill
items.title: New items pill
items.description: A live list never moves what you are reading: new items wait above it and an ink pill drops in over its top edge with the count, rolling as more arrive. A press brings them in: with useBringIn the rows you were reading glide down and the new ones carry a wash that fades.

items.name: night-ribbon
items.title: Night ribbon
items.description: Awake, REM, Light and Deep as lanes, each stretch a rounded capsule in the stage's tint joined to the next by a soft riser, so the night reads as one ribbon. The longest deep stretch glows with its pill; the axis says bedtime, a few hours and wake, and the table carries every stretch.

items.name: night-tags
items.title: Night tags
items.description: Tags on a night from the Log and the routine, each with its time, with Add a tag and, when the coach has one, a single cited correlation about your own nights with its source in mono. A fact, never advice.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A number typed or stepped, shown in the reader's locale (money, percent) and plain while typing. Enter commits, Esc reverts; steppers and arrows step (Shift ten), Home and End reach the limits, the label scrubs. Holding a stepper repeats, speeding up; a count rolls each step, never money.

items.name: operation
items.title: Operation
items.description: OperationPill sits in the top bar's right slot and is the whole surface for a job: the spinner and a rolling count (Moving 12 of 40) with Cancel, the tick or the rose dot, Undo; pressed, its list grows out of it. useOperation runs a change: pending, done, or failed with a reason and Retry.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: The assistant's light, a lit body that says what the assistant is doing: Ready turns and breathes, Listening sends soft rings from the rim, Thinking circles its inner light, Speaking runs one crest round the rim, Done sends one green ring out and keeps the tick. Mood changes glide; one still per mood with less motion.

items.name: overlay-chips
items.title: Overlay chips
items.description: Toggle chips under a trend: the one on shows its swatch, name and latest reading and takes it off again; the rest wait as quiet + chips. A caption under them says what is on (`caption`, or the label). One overlay at a time, so the chart keeps one honest axis.

items.name: page-heading
items.title: Page heading
items.description: One heading for every page: back, the title, a meta line of facts, then the actions with the one primary rightmost. In the page, once you scroll past the title it moves into a compact bar so the name and the primary stay in reach; as a top bar the same parts sit in the 48px band.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A long list or table a page at a time: the range at the start ("21–40 of 2,418"), rolling as the page turns, then the arrows and a fixed window of seven pages, so the row never changes width. The current page wears one raised pill, in ink; it glides, and a shifting window moves as a belt. Narrow: "Page 2 of 121".

items.name: parsed-ask
items.title: Parsed ask
items.description: A person types what they want in their own words ("Chase Priya for the signed order form Thursday, high") and Enter reads it. Each part it found sits under it as a chip: a quiet name, its value. A chip with options opens its own picker; a pick reruns only the count, never the model.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password strength
items.description: Under a new password, in the field's hint: a hairline meter, then the word and its reason ("Fair, add a word or two"). Under the minimum it says Too short; then Weak, Fair, Good or Strong, from the length and the kinds of character, with the plainest common words refused. Meter and word take the status colour.

items.name: permission-mode
items.title: Permission mode
items.description: Three modes, each saying what it allows: Ask every time, Ask before changes, Act on its own. One line never changes: deleting, paying and sending outside always ask, whatever the mode. A segmented control with the mode's line in settings; a chip that opens to the three on a composer's row.

items.name: person-card
items.title: Person card
items.description: A person's role, team, local time and open work in a small card that opens on hover or focus of their face or name, without leaving the page. With href the trigger links to their page (a touch goes there); without, it is a button a press opens. Company card is the same card for a company.

items.name: personal-bests
items.title: Personal bests
items.description: Quiet fact rows for a metric (highest night, best month, longest run over your usual), each with its value and date. No badges and no colour: a best is a fact, not a prize. With `onOpen`, each row is a button that opens its day; nothing is edited. A month without readings says when bests arrive.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: A phone number in any country, shown in its groups and handed over as one international number (+447700900123). The country key opens a searchable list, likely ones first; a pasted number picks its country, +1 by area code. The line says how many digits are left or that it looks right. Looks: plain, and slots.

items.name: phone-tab-bar
items.title: Phone tab bar
items.description: The tabs a thumb reaches, docked and frosted at a phone's foot. One raised pill glides to the tab you're on; unread shows as a count, a dot means something needs you; More holds every other page and lights while you're on one; the app's one action (+ Log) is the last slot.

items.name: plan-list
items.title: Plan list
items.description: The plan an agent proposes, edited as a draft (reorder, add a step, ask for one more, each row with the host's owner and estimate cells), then approved into a live checklist: the grips become status glyphs, the step at work sweeps, the head counts and clocks. A failed step says why and retries or skips in place.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Content that opens from a control and stays while you read or work in it: who is on a deal, a filter's few fields. Never a list of actions (that is a Menu). The one popup surface, raised and floating; a bottom sheet on a phone. title names it; Esc or a press outside closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: priority-mark
items.title: Priority mark
items.description: A priority at 14px without colour: three ink bars climbing from low to high, a filled ink square for urgent, a faint dashed line for none. It says its level to a screen reader.

items.name: prism-edge
items.title: Prism edge
items.description: A hairline of the Signature turning through its light round a glass card, with a whisper of spectral tint at one corner, all code. When something new arrives it sweeps once in about 1.2 s and rests; never on a mount, and under reduced motion the edge simply shows. Used once per app.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: One rounded row: attach, words, microphone, Send. The agent row keeps five marks: one +, the mode chip off its default, the model with its effort, the context ring, Send; Stop's arc fills as the reply streams. The microphone makes the row a recorder; nothing sends on its own. Refused or offline, it says why.

items.name: property-pill
items.title: Property pill
items.description: A field's value as a pill you change where it sits: PropertyPillMenu blooms our menu from it, a pick folds it back, the mark and word roll and the tint crosses over. Only the ends carry colour (Won, Done, Solved green; Lost rose), their marks saying it too. PropertyPill alone is a trigger for any picker.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR code
items.description: A scannable code from its own encoder (up to 382 characters at the highest correction): softened modules, rounded finder eyes, ink on a white tile with its quiet zone, white in dark too. A mark in the middle lifts the correction to H. It draws once from the finder corners, then holds still.

items.name: question-card
items.title: Question card
items.description: An agent asks in the run's own place and waits: a choice among a few, a short form from a flat schema, or a link to sign in. Accept is worded for the job, beside Decline and, with its handler, Cancel run. Answered it folds to one line with Change and focus moves there; declining ends the step, not the run.

items.name: question-list
items.title: Question list
items.description: Questions as full-width rows on hairlines, the answer growing into place under its question, and a plus at the row's end that turns to a minus when open. Opening one folds the others, or several stay open with multiple. Alone, it names what it folds ("Show 3 more fields"). Arrow keys walk the questions.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio cards
items.description: One choice from a few where each option needs a line: icon, option, line and radio dot; the chosen one has an ink edge, arrows move it. Rows or equal tracks (3 across, 2×2), never an orphan; an unavailable option says why. The list variant is the plain radio group; the swatch variant a named colour choice.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One of a few short choices in a form or a setting: a dot before each option, its line under it when it needs one, the question written over the group as its legend. Tab enters at the chosen option, arrows move the choice and skip an unavailable one, which says why. It is Radio cards' list form.

items.name: rating-reasons
items.title: Rating with reasons
items.description: Two quiet thumbs with a reply's other actions; a press fills the chosen one over its outline, so nothing resizes. Up is said and done. Down opens a small card on a spring: what went wrong as chips, an optional line and Send. Sent, one line of thanks takes its place, its tick drawn once, and focus rests there.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Five ink steps scored by a click, a key or a finger drawn along them. The chosen run fills left to right and its last step pops; the word says the score. A score under three asks what went wrong in place, and one tap on a reason sends it. Read-only shows a score as one image. kind="thumbs" is the reply's thumbs.

items.name: reactions
items.title: Reactions
items.description: A message acknowledged in one tap. Each reaction is a chip that says who felt what and is the button to agree; yours is the one Signature chip. The face offers a set, then any emoji. A pick flies to its chip and acts out its meaning; the count rolls; the tip shows faces and names; a chip at 0 leaves and the gap closes.

items.name: read-aloud
items.title: Read aloud
items.description: An answer with its action row. Read aloud turns the row into a compact player in the same slot, so the text never moves. One highlight glides word to word with the voice; pressing a word picks up there. Its level bars follow the playback and gather into the play mark at the end. Speed steps 1× to 2×; voice is a menu.

items.name: reason-popover
items.title: Reason popover
items.description: A step that needs one line of why before it runs (deny, decline, pause), asked where it was pressed: one question naming the object and who reads the answer, a few one-line choices and Something else…, which alone opens a field. Enter runs it. For steps Undo can take back; an irreversible one is a Dialog.

items.name: reorderable-list
items.title: Reorderable list
items.description: A person's own list put in order by hand (pipeline stages, statuses, saved views). Drag a row by its grip: it lifts flat on the float shadow, stays under the pointer, neighbours glide aside and it lands where it is let go; Esc sends it home. The row's ⋯ menu and Alt+↑ ↓ move it without a pointer.

items.name: results-strip
items.title: Results strip
items.description: A whole panel at a glance: one tick per result, grouped by system, in range quiet ink, out of range warn, a value to check outlined bad, with the counts written. Point or use the arrow keys to read a tick (one tab stop); press, Enter or Space opens it. The host orders the items.

items.name: reveal-button
items.title: Reveal button
items.description: A call to action that says where it goes: a square ink button with its arrow and quiet words beside it. Hover or focus grows the ink out under the words on a spring, the words turn white and the arrow steps toward them; a press darts the arrow on. On touch the first tap opens it, the second acts.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: A row your action adds or removes grows into place and folds away instead of popping, so what's below moves smoothly. It animates only on your change; closed content is inert, and reduced motion swaps at once.

items.name: rolling-clock
items.title: Rolling clock
items.description: Rolling number's clock form for every clock that ticks: m:ss or h:mm:ss in tabular Geist, the colon fixed. A changed digit turns one step the short way, up counting up and down counting down; h:mm:ss reserves its hour so it never widens. variant "time" shows a time of day, 24 or 12 hours.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling number
items.description: A count that changes because of what you did rolls only the digits that changed, ones first, each carry a beat later. Plain is calm in an app; variant drum is the showpiece: a slab window of 3D wheels that only turn forward. Held, pace shortens the turns. Never a price.

items.name: route-map
items.title: Route map
items.description: GPS points in Web Mercator at the zoom that fits them, over XYZ tiles, a vector street map in the page's roles (roads by class, buildings, grass, water, names along roads) or paper. The line is the signal with its glow: start dot, finish flag clear of the line, km marks, a record badge under its stretch, a live dot.

items.name: route-trace
items.title: Route trace
items.description: GPS points projected flat and fitted to the box on the page's own paper, drawn in the series hue over a soft halo with a hollow start, the finish as the focus mark and each whole kilometre's mark, its number stepped off the line. No tiles and no provider key; a buyer adds streets behind the same drawing.

items.name: ruler
items.title: Ruler
items.description: Hairline ticks at an even step, the band as the solid stretch at its foot and the value as one taller mark, the band's limits in tabular figures. Sits under a hero number so it reads as a measurement: HRV against its usual, a lab result, a build's duration.

items.name: run-summary
items.title: Run summary
items.description: How a run ended, in a few lines under it. Done: what it did, what changed, what it spent, See changes. Failed: the step named, why in the danger ink, Retry from that step and Keep what's done. Stopped is a person's act, never red. Stale says what is known with its dotted clock, never a spinner.

items.name: save-bar
items.title: Save bar
items.description: A compact dark bar that rises under a form once a field changes: the count of unsaved changes (it rolls), Discard and Save. Save waits for the server, then the bar folds to "✓ Saved" and leaves; a refusal says why in the bar. Its slot keeps its height, or folds at rest (rest="fold"). Cmd or Ctrl S saves.

items.name: scout-suggestion
items.title: Scout suggestion
items.description: Scout's one suggestion beside the work it is about: his orb hops in, his name, then the action chip pops. One press accepts it: the chip squashes, turns green with a drawn tick and its words roll to what he is now doing, and a note rises under it saying who reviews the work.

items.name: screen-view
items.title: Screen view
items.description: The agent's screen at its size, scaled to fit. Its named cursor travels to each action with a soft trail, a click lands as a ripple, its caption writing itself below. Take over hands you the cursor; Hand back returns it. Sensitive steps ask first: Confirm or take over. Done says what came of it; a failed load Retries.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: One scroll for every strip that holds more than it shows (tabs, a filter bar, a timeline, a board). The browser's own scroll, so wheel, trackpad, swipe and arrows all move it; an edge fades only while there is more past it; a thin bar shows while you scroll or point, fading 800ms after.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: Filters what is on the page as you type. Esc clears it, a clear button (44px on touch) appears once there is text, and a printed shortcut key focuses it. The query is value or defaultValue; its words come from labels. Small beside a table's tabs or wide at the top of a list.

items.name: secret-reveal
items.title: Secret reveal
items.description: A secret shown the one time it exists outside the server (a new API key): the whole value in mono, selectable, one Copy that says Copied, and a plain line saying it won't be shown again.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: Section heading
items.description: One title size in every app (16px in the display face), an optional count beside it in the same face, a hint in readable ink under it and one quiet action at the end, on the title's baseline; `rule` draws a hairline under it for a section on the ground. Given children it is the section itself, named by its title.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Two to five views or modes of the same thing (List | Board), one always chosen: raised on a thumb in a toned track, or filling its segment in a joined group (variant "joined"), a button's height either way. Arrow keys move between options; a count sits on the label's baseline.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one of a short, known list; it drops below the control, a sheet on a phone. A field select sits in a form; a property select is the compact chip a side panel changes in place. label, hint and error put it in a Field; a disabled one reads its reason in the hint's place. value or defaultValue.

items.name: selection-prompt
items.title: Selection prompt
items.description: Select text and ask for a change in one floating bar under it, with a few quick asks. Sent, the ask becomes a live label and the bar holds Stop while the change is written in as hunks. Written, it narrows to what changed with Undo, Again and Keep (Mod+Enter). It never closes: it changes job and width on the spring.

items.name: shortcut-recorder
items.title: Shortcut recorder
items.description: The app's keys in a list, each row's keys a button. Press one and press the new chord: it is stored as mod+shift+l, matched by the physical key so any layout records the same one. A chord another row owns offers Keep looking or Swap; the browser's own are refused in words; Esc keeps the old keys. Reset puts a row back.

items.name: shortcut-sheet
items.title: Shortcut sheet
items.description: The app's keys in their groups, fed by its own key map so it prints only keys that work. It opens with ? anywhere and ⌘/ inside a field; a find field filters it as you type, and pressing a key while the list has focus lights its row.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side panel
items.description: A record opened beside the list it came from. It isn't modal: the list stays usable and another row swaps the record. J and K step through the list; Esc closes. On a phone it takes the screen above the tab bar.

items.name: skeleton-reveal
items.title: Skeleton reveal
items.description: The shape of what's coming while it loads, then the real rows in its place with no jump. No skeleton under 300 ms, and once shown it stays 400 ms; one light sweeps the region; the rows rise in. Or turns: each line resolves in reading order, figures last. A failed load keeps the box with Try again.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A rough value on a scale: a button-high recessed bar with its name inside at the start and its value at the end, an ink fill to the value and a thin ink knob just inside the fill's end. Press or drag anywhere; the arrows step (Shift ten). A pair is a range with two knobs; marks draw a stepped scale.

items.name: sortable-header
items.title: Sortable header
items.description: A table column you can sort by: press to sort, again to flip. Each column has a natural first direction (names A to Z, money high to low), so the first press gives the useful order. The th carries aria-sort.

items.name: span-timeline
items.title: Span timeline
items.description: A run on one time axis, a lane per actor, resting finished and drawn. Spans say what each was doing by texture: thinking quiet, tools a deeper ink, and the wait on you, the one tinted thing, its length the head's figure. A press on the axis replays from there; live, the wait grows on the wall clock with the ask.

items.name: spark-bars
items.title: Spark bars
items.description: One 3px bar per period with no axes, in the series tint with rounded tops: the last bars are the full series hue and a run of silent periods turns them to the warning colour; `flagged` periods draw in the bad colour. In a table or list row they rest grey and the row you point at or select takes the series hue.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A trend at a glance, with no axes: a smooth line in the series hue over a wash that fades, ending in a dot; a band behind it can mark the usual range. In a table or list row it rests grey and the row you point at or select takes the series hue. Amounts per period are Spark bars.

items.name: spend-chip
items.title: Spend chip
items.description: What a run spent (credits, tokens or money) against its cap, in tabular digits that roll in a width reserved for the cap's figure. Near the cap it says "near cap" and the bolt turns warn; at the cap "cap reached" in danger. Money takes its currency's format; inline it is the bolt and figure alone.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Inline "working", the size of the text it sits in: one small dot travels a faint track in the text colour. Done, the lap it is on closes the ring into the green tick; failed, the dot drops to a rose dot. Busy holds 400ms so a quick job never flashes, and onSettled tells the words beside it when to change.

items.name: split-bar
items.title: Split bar
items.description: Where things sit right now, as one bar split into its parts: each state in its own colour, at a cumulative flow's strengths, and a key writing every count, a zero included. The part you point at widens; with onSelect a key opens the records it counts, otherwise it toggles its part and the rest reflow.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: One default verb joined to a chevron that opens a small menu of its close variants (Publish, Schedule, Save as draft), anchored to the button at every width, parted by a hairline seam so it reads as one action. The verb does the verb: Publishing…, then the green tick; a pick crossfades the verb.

items.name: splitter
items.title: Splitter
items.description: The edge between two regions, dragged to give one more room. A real separator: arrows resize it in steps, Home and End go to the smallest and largest size, Enter folds the region away and back, a double-click puts the width back. It draws the grip and focus ring; the width stays with the host.

items.name: stage-chips
items.title: Stage chips
items.description: Each stage's total as a chip with its swatch; the stage that stands out is raised and carries its usual in mono. A plain list, read the same by a screen reader.

items.name: stage-path
items.title: Stage path
items.description: Where a record is in its process: passed stages with their days, the current one solid, later ones grey. With onMove, press a stage to move the record there; without it the path is read-only text. A closed record ends in its outcome, done or dropped, named by the app (Won and Lost for a deal), and how long it took.

items.name: status-glyph-run
items.title: Status glyph, run states
items.description: A run's state, a shape each: queued (dashed ring), running (the one lit state, a Signature arc turning), waiting on you (warn, one ping), paused (the arc frozen), done (ok fill, the tick draws), failed (a danger cross), stopped (an ink square, never red) and stale (a dotted ring with a clock).

items.name: status-glyph
items.title: Status glyph
items.description: Where an item stands, by shape, so colour stays for exceptions: a dashed ring for backlog, a ring for to do, half for in progress, three quarters for review, a slash for cancelled, all ink; done fills green with a tick. Given onComplete it is the button that finishes the item (it pops once). labels names each state.

items.name: steer-queue
items.title: Steer queue
items.description: The follow-ups a person types while a run works, waiting above the box in the order they will go, each sent after the current step. Drag to reorder (the menu and Alt+arrows for keys), Send now to steer the run at its next step, the cross to take one back. It never sends on its own.

items.name: steps-timed
items.title: Steps timed
items.description: Steps' timed form, for a piece that loops through its parts (a hero that asks, plans and answers). The playing part's bar fills over its time and the next part slides in; a press on a bar jumps there and holds it until pressed again. With less motion it rests on the last part, every bar full.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Where a flow in steps is. Bars by default, read as a player under "Step 3 of 4 · Import", the current one stretched and filling with its progress; the numbered rail (variant "rail") ticks done steps for a long flow you jump around in. Progress is ink; a failed step is red with its fix and Retry.

items.name: streak-dots
items.title: Streak dots
items.description: One row of dots per item, one per day: filled when it happened, a ring when it didn't, the days to come dashed, the count closing the row. Today's dot pops once as it fills. Three uses: a habit kept day by day, a nightly build green or red, a team's daily check-in.

items.name: stream-adapters
items.title: Stream adapters
items.description: The data every agentic piece takes, typed once: the AI SDK's parts verbatim, and our run, plan, approval, question, cost and change. A run has eight states; a tool call's seven read as six words. Each format's word for a run's state (AI SDK, AG-UI, A2A, MCP, OpenAI Agents, Linear) maps onto the eight in one table.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: A row's actions in two trays under it, mirrored in its menu and keys. The row follows the finger and uncovers its tiles from the edge in; past half the tray it stops open; past the line the outermost tile floods across and letting go commits it. A delete never takes the long swipe; Undo brings the row back.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that takes effect the moment it flips, with no Save. Off is a quiet track, on is the Signature. label and hint make a settings row (the words lead, the switch at the end); children are words inline after it. Disabled with a reason, the reason reads in the hint's place. On touch the hit area grows to 48px.

items.name: system-glyph
items.title: System glyph
items.description: An empty ring is none, a half moon is half, a full disc is all: a shape, not a colour, always beside its count in words.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between the views of one thing in place: an agent's Plan, Running and Receipt, or a list's saved views (All 17 · Mine 3). The drop form sits the chosen tab in solid ink and moves it like a drop; a dot says a view needs you. The pill form stretches a soft pill and carries saved views, their … menu and More.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: A Field with a native input or textarea in the system's well. A native input's props pass through, so browsers and password managers keep working. Give it a label or an aria-label. className styles the field, inputClassName the input; a disabled one reads its reason in the hint's place; the clear is 44px on touch.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: Flips light and dark in one press, calm and all ink: a ghost icon button whose sun and moon crossfade, a pill switch whose knob glides as its track turns from a faint well to ink, and a button naming where a press goes, its words crossfading. applyTheme crossfades the colours.

items.name: thinking-fold
items.title: Thinking fold
items.description: A reply's thinking, folded always. Live it is one line of a fixed height, "Thinking 7 s" and the current thought in ink-3, so nothing under it moves. Finished, it settles in place to "Thought for 7 s"; stopped mid-thought, it keeps what it had and says where. Only the reader opens it.

items.name: threshold-chart
items.title: Threshold chart
items.description: One series read against the line it must stay under (latency against a budget) or over (uptime against a floor): the y-axis, hairlines and every date, the target solid in ink and named at its end. Pointing or the arrow keys draw the crosshair and light the point; a click pins it. A stop past it says so in words.

items.name: tick-bar
items.title: Tick bar
items.description: How far toward a target, as thin ticks filled up to the value: done in green, the committed rest in grey, an ink tick at the goal. A rise lifts the new ticks left to right with a ripple; at the goal a green check pops and the goal is said once. A short count draws one segment a step; a tap reads it on touch.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time picker
items.description: A meeting's start: type it any way ("2:30pm", "930", "2p", "noon") or click to open the dial: the suggested slots as one row, then an hour column and a minute column that roll to the pick. A time someone can't take is greyed with its reason. 12 or 24 hours follows its locale (en-US unless given) unless set.

items.name: title-description
items.title: Title and description
items.description: The head of a record that opens like a page: a small line naming what it is, the title in the page's title type and a description under it, each edited in place (Enter saves, Esc puts it back). Each shows the saved mark once its save resolved. Facts about the record sit on one line under a hairline.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Says what just happened in two lines, with the one way back (Undo) or Retry on a failure. Up to three stack as a deck, each new one pushing the last a step back; pointing fans them. Every toast has its ×, which returns focus; news stays 4 s, an Undo 6 s with ⌘Z, a failure until closed. Mount the Toaster once.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: OpenBot's clean floating toolbar of toggles: a raised bar over a blur, its keys 30px squares. Toggles (bold, italic, underline, a highlight) and one exclusive set (alignment) sit apart by a hairline; on and hover share the wash and ink, colour only. One tab stop; the arrows, Home and End roam it.

items.name: token-field
items.title: Token field
items.description: People, addresses or tags as chips in one field. Enter or a comma adds the first match; Backspace arms the last chip, again removes it. A pasted list bursts in a chip at a time: one already in hops, a new address comes in dashed, new to the thread, and what isn't an address stays as rose text.

items.name: tool-row
items.title: Tool row
items.description: One tool call, read from the stream's part: present tense while it runs and its clock counts; past tense and outcome when done, the tick drawn; failed says what failed with Retry and Skip; denied stays ink. When it needs a yes, the gate opens in the row. A press opens its input and output: text, list, table or JSON.

items.name: tool-stack
items.title: Tool stack
items.description: Avatar stack's grammar for tools: the apps one agent turn used, overlapping, each cut out of its surface by a 2px ring, then "+N" past four. A tool that joins while you watch slides in and the stack widens. It reads as one phrase, so the row holding it says its own words beside it.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that is one tab stop: the arrows (and Home, End) walk its buttons and Tab returns to the one last focused. A toggle in it (Bold) latches: it sinks into the well and stays sunk. Variant "joined" holds a set acting on one thing (‹ Today ›, Bold Italic Underline) on one hairline, short seams between.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names something with no words of its own (an icon button, cut-off text) and its key. It grows from the trigger: a bead leaves its edge and unfurls into the tip, then folds back on leave or Esc. 280ms the first time, at once while you scan; focus shows it. Its key sinks the cap.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The provenance line under a reading (Ring / 07:02, Northside Lab · 16 Oct); pressed, it opens the slip: the source, when it was measured, the range it was read against and who set that range. The receipt's face, for a value.

items.name: transfer-card
items.title: Transfer card
items.description: Told in the thread of the hand-off. Waiting is two lines: who is being found, the wait in words, then the summary they'll read, so nothing is asked twice. Connected folds to a line with their photo; resolved is a receipt. With no one free it takes a message, says when they'll reply, and keeps the assistant in reach.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: Things inside other things (folders and files, teams and projects): open a branch, pick a row. Hierarchy is the indent alone, a level a chevron's slot, no guide lines. The chosen row's wash runs the full width; a long name truncates with a tooltip; a branch's rows arrive in turn as it opens.

items.name: voice-input
items.title: Voice input
items.description: A text area with a quiet microphone in its footer that grows into the recorder in place (Cancel, the level, the clock, Insert), so the field never moves. Heard words land grey and turn ink once final; a corrected word refades alone. Silence lays the bars down into a hairline. A blocked microphone says how to allow it.

items.name: crm
items.title: CRM template
items.description: A finished CRM: pipeline, forecast, quotes, inbox, reports and settings, every state and both themes designed. Mount CrmApp and pass an adapter for your API.

items.name: task-management
items.title: Task Management template
items.description: Finished task management: boards, cycles, a timeline and insights, every state and both themes designed. Mount TasksApp and pass an adapter for your API (a reference HTTP adapter and routes included).

items.name: assistant
items.title: Assistant template
items.description: A finished AI assistant: chat with a receipt on every reply, a document workspace, projects, assistants, approvals and plans with usage, every state and both themes designed. Mount AssistantApp and pass an adapter for your model backend (reference/route.ts is one on the AI SDK).

items.name: health
items.title: Health template
items.description: A finished personal health app: lab results read against their ranges, wearable trends, body pages, a coach that cites your values, a care-team thread and clinician sharing, every state and both themes designed. Mount HealthApp and pass an adapter for your API (a reference HTTP adapter and routes included).

items.name: assistant-launch
items.title: Launch template
items.description: The site that sells your AI product, paired with the Assistant: a hero that is the app's own demo, live product tiles, what's new, plans from the app's own PLANS, questions and a close, plus a changelog page. Installs the Assistant with it. Render LaunchPage at / and /changelog.
